semanticAssessment: The target executed and failed on its planned assertion: the start count kept rising past the 2-minute mark, which is the alarm-fatigue defect the ruling caps. Observed 9 failing entries / 71 passing (80 tests in 4 loaded files plus 1 file that failed to load) against the prediction. Predicted and observed failing: editor pre-fill/amber/24-hour hint, editor partial-fix save, editor Sunday-spill refusal, card plural and singular, pause shop-access-denied 403, alarm 120 s cap. Predicted passes that passed: alarm mute case, NEEDS_REVIEW untouched save, the existing Silence-alarm test. Three differences, each explained: (1) the registry guard file failed to load (Cannot find module kitchen-route-calls) because the registry module is created by the GREEN step, so it could not pass by design at RED; its falsifiers remain break arms R1/R2. (2) the non-typed 403 case failed: on the unfixed tree EVERY 403 shows the manager-referral copy, so the generic describeLoadError message is a behaviour this package adds. (3) the existing 200-character long-text layout test failed because its locator now matches the ruled wording We could not read; the layout assertions themselves are unchanged.
